title: Inventory and Weather
author: Lena Ashgrove
blurb: Silas Delacroix, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
